This will be the first Miss America pageant to be held in Atlantic City since the Miss America Organization headquarters relocated to Boardwalk Hall.

She also held the title of Missouri's Junior Miss 2005 and competed at nationals with future Miss America Katie Stam.
Miss America 2003 | Miss America 2003, the 76th Miss America pageant, was televised live from Boardwalk Hall in Atlantic City, New Jersey on September 21, 2002 on the ABC Network.  The pageant was won by Erika Harold of Illinois.
